title: pool fd double-close protection: fd cleared to -1 inside lock before returning to caller
description: pool_acquire() sets pool->slots[i].fd = -1 inside the mutex immediately after copying fd to a local variable, before returning. This ensures that a concurrent pool_cleanup() (which checks fd >= 0 under the same lock) cannot close the same fd the caller is about to use. Without this, cleanup racing with an in-progress acquire could double-close the fd. A contributor simplifying the code might remove the -1 assignment as 'unnecessary'. It is not — it is the double-close guard.
